ntm.interpretation: present in a subset of the genus (3/53 NTM; in 2 of the 4 closest MTBAP relatives) — partial/intermediate conservation
ntm.source: presence/absence by tblastn vs ~53 assembled non-MTBC Mycobacterium genomes (annotation_mtbc P10.2)

phylostratum.interpretation: present across the genus Mycobacterium (NTM) but not detected in any non-Mycobacterium genome — a Mycobacterium-genus gene
phylostratum.source: cross-genus phylostratigraphy: tblastn vs 13 non-Mycobacterium reference genomes (Mycobacteriaceae>Corynebacteriales>Actinomycetia>outside-phylum) + intra-genus NTM presence (annotation_mtbc P10.3)

rbtnseq_fitness.lead: transposon mutants are specifically enriched under Isoniazid (stress) (RB-TnSeq log2=1.7, t=6.783), i.e. loss of the gene confers a fitness advantage there — candidate Isoniazid-susceptibility/activation factor whose disruption is beneficial.
rbtnseq_fitness.source: RB-TnSeq 95-condition barcoded transposon screen, Mtb (PLoS Biol 2026, doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003529)
